This kinase is subsequently linked to Ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase family member 6, indicating a possible pathway where Quassin may influence the activity of CDC2L1, which then affects the activity of the phosphodiesterase. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory mechanism involving kinase activity and phosphodiesterase function, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on a single score, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct relationship between Quassin and the phosphodiesterase.
